title: Partner security review
subtitle: Acme Prints (fictional) · example knowledge base
fallback: Let me check that and confirm in writing.

cards.title: Opening: introductions
say: Hi, this is Alex from Acme Prints. Thanks for making the time. Anything I can't answer today, I'll confirm in writing.
cards.note: Mở đầu: giới thiệu, hẹn trả lời bằng văn bản những câu chưa chắc.
cards.keywords: hello intro introductions who are you

cards.title: Do you enforce MFA?
say: Staff sign in through single sign-on with MFA. Our seller-facing app does not have MFA yet; it is first on our plan.
facts: ⚠️ No MFA on the seller app yet.
cards.note: MFA: nhân viên có, app cho seller chưa có. Nói thẳng, kèm kế hoạch.
cards.keywords: mfa 2fa two factor multi-factor authentication login otp

cards.title: Encryption at rest: is customer data encrypted?
say: Yes. Our databases and file storage are encrypted with AES-256, using managed keys.
cards.keywords: encryption at rest encrypted aes kms database disk storage

cards.title: Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+?
say: All traffic uses HTTPS with TLS 1.2 or newer, and database connections require TLS.
facts: ✅ TLS 1.2 minimum on every public hostname.

cards.title: Logging: what do you log, how long, who reviews?
say: Every cloud API call is logged. Application logs are kept 90 days today; we are moving to 12 months with a review every two weeks.
facts: ✅ Cloud audit log in all regions.
⚠️ App logs 90 days; no regular review yet.
cards.note: Log: đạt một phần (lưu 90 ngày, chưa review định kỳ).
cards.keywords: log logging monitoring audit trail alert review retention

cards.title: Backups and recovery: retention, restore tests?
say: Database backups run every day and are kept 7 days. We are adding a cross-region copy and a documented restore test.
facts: ⚠️ 7-day retention; no restore test on record.
cards.note: Backup: có, nhưng chưa test khôi phục.

cards.title: Do you delete buyer data after delivery?
say: Yes. Buyer names, addresses and phone numbers are removed 30 days after delivery.
cards.note: Xoá dữ liệu người mua sau 30 ngày: đạt.
cards.keywords: retention delete deletion purge 30 days personal data

cards.title: Who do you share buyer data with?
say: Only with the carrier that delivers the order, and only the name and shipping address. We never sell or market with it.
cards.note: Chia sẻ dữ liệu: chỉ hãng vận chuyển.
cards.keywords: share sharing third party subcontractor vendor partner carrier sell

cards.title: "When will you fix it?" / timeline
say: I'd rather not give you a date I haven't confirmed. We'll send a dated plan for each item in writing.
facts: Ask back: what remediation window do you expect?
cards.keywords: when date timeline deadline fix plan remediation

lifelines: Sorry, could you repeat that, a little more slowly?
I don't want to give you an inaccurate answer. Let me check and confirm in writing.
Just to confirm: you need [item], in [format], by [date]?
dontSay: No dates on the call that you have not checked.
docs: Acme Prints is a fictional print-on-demand company. Staff use single sign-on with MFA; the seller app has password login only. Databases and object storage are encrypted with AES-256 using cloud-managed keys. Public endpoints require TLS 1.2+. Cloud API audit logging is on in every region; application logs are kept 90 days. Database backups are daily with 7-day retention; no restore test is on record. Buyer name, address and phone are purged 30 days after delivery and shared only with the delivering carrier. Incident response: an on-call engineer is paged by monitoring; there is a written incident runbook but no tabletop exercise yet. Vulnerability scanning of container images runs on every build. Employees complete security training at onboarding.
demo: Thanks for joining. Let's get started with introductions.
